catalog.exclusion_reason: DEEP_PIPELINE enumerates every simple source-to-sink path (nx.all_simple_paths) and emits one finding per path: 247,761 findings on the 29-component tiny_system fixture, and no termination within ten minutes on the 50-application healthcare topology. Excluding it is the only way to measure the remaining detectors; the blowup is itself a reportable result.

critical_set_rule: Box-plot top tier (>= Q3) when n >= 20, else top-20% percentile; applied identically to prediction and truth, per saag/validation/validator.py. For the Q(v)/betweenness/degree predictors this pins the two sets to near-equal size, so precision and recall converge by construction. The catalog block is not thresholded this way — its flagged set is whatever the detectors produced — so its precision and recall are independent.

pooling_check.note: False means the pooled figure is not a summary of the per-type figures — a Simpson's-paradox effect — and only the stratified numbers should be quoted.

note: All metrics are rank-based and therefore invariant to the monotone robust_sigmoid rescaling ValidationService applies internally. Scored against I_comp only; I_comp and I* agree at mean rho 0.3950 over 12 scenarios (results/convergent_validity.json), so these figures do not transfer to claims measured against I*.
